samples.reverse_paraphrase: The chapter introduces a signed analytic tableaux system.
samples.assessment: The chapter identity, signed-analytic scope and prfTab profile are preserved after OLTAB-001.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The prfTab tag controls content about tableaux as a proof system; OLTAB-001 repairs the copied reference to natural deduction.
samples.assessment: The chapter identity, signed-analytic scope and prfTab profile are preserved after OLTAB-001.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A tableau systematically explores how sentences may be true or false by arranging truth-signed formulas in a downward-growing tree.
samples.assessment: Signed-formula polarity, downward tree structure, rule application scope and the definitions of branch and tableau closure are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A branch closes when it contains both truth signs for the same formula, and a tableau closes only when every branch does.
samples.assessment: Signed-formula polarity, downward tree structure, rule application scope and the definitions of branch and tableau closure are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A closed tableau rooted in false A eliminates every way A could be false, so A holds in every structure.
samples.assessment: Signed-formula polarity, downward tree structure, rule application scope and the definitions of branch and tableau closure are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Cut may split every branch into a True-A side and a False-A side; it is eliminable but useful for combining tableaux.
samples.assessment: Every propositional rule retains its sign, connective, arity and branching behavior, while Cut retains its optional two-way split.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: True-universal accepts a closed term, while false-universal introduces a constant fresh from the whole preceding branch.
samples.assessment: Closed-term scope, eigenvariable freshness, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample all preserve their rule-specific polarity.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Unrestricted instantiation may reuse a term already in A, but an eigenvariable may not occur in A; the valid and invalid examples preserve that distinction.
samples.assessment: Closed-term scope, eigenvariable freshness, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample all preserve their rule-specific polarity.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Freshness for true-existential and false-universal is required for soundness; omitting it would wrongly close the displayed invalid implication.
samples.assessment: Closed-term scope, eigenvariable freshness, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample all preserve their rule-specific polarity.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A tableau is a finite signed-formula tree with its assumptions at the top and every later formula licensed by a rule applied above it; openness and closure are branchwise.
samples.assessment: The inductive and finite-tree definitions, top assumptions, rule-generated descendants, open branches and closed tableaux are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The example expands true A-and-not-A into true A and true not-A, then obtains false A and closes the branch.
samples.assessment: The inductive and finite-tree definitions, top assumptions, rule-generated descendants, open branches and closed tableaux are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A checkmark records that the unique rule for a signed main connective has been applied on every open branch, rather than merely once somewhere.
samples.assessment: The worked propositional tableaux preserve rule order, checkmark scope, branch propagation, line references and every exercise formula after OLTAB-002.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The second example first branches on true disjunction, propagates false-conditional conclusions to both branches, and closes each branch with opposite signs.
samples.assessment: The worked propositional tableaux preserve rule order, checkmark scope, branch propagation, line references and every exercise formula after OLTAB-002.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The exercise retains each signed premise as a separate formula; OLTAB-002 restores true not-B as a separate assumption instead of placing it inside another formula.
samples.assessment: The worked propositional tableaux preserve rule order, checkmark scope, branch propagation, line references and every exercise formula after OLTAB-002.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Quantified proof search should generally apply eigenvariable-constrained rules before later lines can introduce constants that would violate freshness.
samples.assessment: The quantified examples preserve eigenvariable-first proof search, delayed unrestricted instantiation, constant freshness and every branch dependency.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The worked multi-premise tableau chooses a fresh constant for true-existential before instantiating the unrestricted universal and false-existential rules.
samples.assessment: The quantified examples preserve eigenvariable-first proof search, delayed unrestricted instantiation, constant freshness and every branch dependency.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Unrestricted quantifier rules may need repeated application as new constants appear, so delaying them can avoid duplicating work.
samples.assessment: The quantified examples preserve eigenvariable-first proof search, delayed unrestricted instantiation, constant freshness and every branch dependency.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma derives A exactly when some finite subset of Gamma, signed true, closes together with false A; OLTAB-003 restores the finite-set braces.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, transitivity by Cut and compactness preserve their finite-witness quantifiers after OLTAB-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma is inconsistent exactly when some finite subset of Gamma, with all members signed true, has a closed tableau.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, transitivity by Cut and compactness preserve their finite-witness quantifiers after OLTAB-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Transitivity uses Cut on A: one branch receives the closed tableau deriving B from A and Delta, while the other receives the closed tableau deriving A from Gamma.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, transitivity by Cut and compactness preserve their finite-witness quantifiers after OLTAB-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Proof-theoretic compactness gives a finite subset witnessing derivability, and consistency follows when every finite subset is consistent.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, transitivity by Cut and compactness preserve their finite-witness quantifiers after OLTAB-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The first proposition combines two finite closed tableaux with Cut on A; OLTAB-004 restores the second finite set's final index m.
samples.assessment: All links between derivability and inconsistency preserve negation polarity, Cut branches and tableau transformations after OLTAB-004 and OLTAB-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A closed tableau for false A plus true Gamma becomes one for true not-A plus true Gamma through the true-negation rule; OLTAB-005 restores that rule's premise.
samples.assessment: All links between derivability and inconsistency preserve negation polarity, Cut branches and tableau transformations after OLTAB-004 and OLTAB-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If both Gamma-with-A and Gamma-with-not-A are inconsistent, Cut supplies true A on one branch and false A on the other so the two witnesses can be attached.
samples.assessment: All links between derivability and inconsistency preserve negation polarity, Cut branches and tableau transformations after OLTAB-004 and OLTAB-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The conjunction tableaux derive each conjunct from a true conjunction and derive the true conjunction from both true conjuncts; OLTAB-006 and OLTAB-007 repair malformed sign macros.
samples.assessment: The conjunction, disjunction and conditional derivability claims and their closing branches are preserved after OLTAB-006 and OLTAB-007.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Modus ponens closes both branches of true implication, while false implication closes from either true not-A or true B.
samples.assessment: The conjunction, disjunction and conditional derivability claims and their closing branches are preserved after OLTAB-006 and OLTAB-007.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Strong generalization permits deriving forall-x A(x) from A(c) only when c occurs in neither Gamma nor A(x).
samples.assessment: Strong generalization preserves both freshness restrictions, and the existential and universal derivability tableaux retain their signs after OLTAB-008.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The proof replaces false A(c) with false forall-x A(x) and inserts false A(c); freshness makes the false-universal inference valid.
samples.assessment: Strong generalization preserves both freshness restrictions, and the existential and universal derivability tableaux retain their signs after OLTAB-008.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Every rule extension preserves at least one satisfiable branch, whereas a closed tableau has no satisfiable branch because each contains opposite signs for one formula.
samples.assessment: Signed satisfaction, preservation under each rule, branch splitting and all three soundness corollaries preserve semantic polarity after OLTAB-009.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Each nonbranching propositional case adds exactly the signed consequences forced by a model of the premise branch.
samples.assessment: Signed satisfaction, preservation under each rule, branch splitting and all three soundness corollaries preserve semantic polarity after OLTAB-009.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For false-universal, a fresh constant is reinterpreted as a counterexample object without changing satisfaction of the preceding branch; OLTAB-009 keeps A consistent throughout.
samples.assessment: Signed satisfaction, preservation under each rule, branch splitting and all three soundness corollaries preserve semantic polarity after OLTAB-009.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A, tableau soundness forces every structure satisfying Gamma to satisfy A, yielding semantic consequence.
samples.assessment: Signed satisfaction, preservation under each rule, branch splitting and all three soundness corollaries preserve semantic polarity after OLTAB-009.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Symmetry follows by reflexivity and signed identity substitution; OLTAB-011 restores A(s1) as the prerequisite that yields A(s2).
samples.assessment: Identity introduction, signed substitution, symmetry, transitivity and the exercise formulas are preserved after OLTAB-010 and OLTAB-011.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Transitivity substitutes s3 for s2 in s1=s2 using s2=s3; OLTAB-010 restores the instantiated equality named on line 2.
samples.assessment: Identity introduction, signed substitution, symmetry, transitivity and the exercise formulas are preserved after OLTAB-010 and OLTAB-011.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Identity soundness transfers satisfaction from A(t1) to A(t2) because true t1=t2 gives equal denotations; the false-signed case is analogous.
samples.assessment: Identity soundness preserves reflexivity, equality of term values, extensionality transfer and signed polarity after OLTAB-012.
